longform.closing: Shanghai Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.

spokenScript: Shanghai can stage fashion inside the material history of textile production itself.

The system: industrial reuse, modular staging, venue conversion.
